description: Search Google Hotels live via SerpAPI. Returns properties (hotels and, with vacation_rentals, rentals) with names, prices/rates, overall ratings, review counts, amenities, images and location, plus the brands/property_types/amenities filter ids you can feed back in. Requires q (a destination, area or hotel name), check_in_date and check_out_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Every property in the results carries a `property_token`: pass it back here (keeping the same check_in_date/check_out_date) to get that one property's full details, or hand it to google_hotels_photos and google_hotels_reviews. Paginate with next_page_token. Prices are in `currency` (default USD). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, search_metadata, search_parameters, search_information, brands, ads, properties: [...], serpapi_pagination } — the list key is `properties` (ads are separate). Each property: { type, name, property_token, link, gps_coordinates, rate_per_night: { lowest, extracted_lowest }, total_rate, prices: [{ source, num_guests, rate_per_night }], overall_rating, reviews, hotel_class (label), extracted_hotel_class (number), amenities, images: [{ thumbnail, original_image }], nearby_places, description }. With property_token the single property's fields come back at the top level instead of `properties`.

amenities.description: Filter by amenities: comma-separated amenity ids (see amenities in a prior response).

bathrooms.description: Minimum number of bathrooms. Vacation rentals only. Default 0.

bedrooms.description: Minimum number of bedrooms. Vacation rentals only. Default 0.

brands.description: Filter by hotel brand: comma-separated brand ids (see brands in a prior response). Not applicable to vacation rentals.

children_ages.description: Ages of the children as comma-separated values, e.g. '5,8'. Each age 1-17; the count should match `children`.

currency.description: Currency of returned prices (ISO code, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'). Default USD.

eco_certified.description: Only show eco-certified properties. Default false.

free_cancellation.description: Only show properties offering free cancellation. Default false.

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

hotel_class.description: Filter by hotel class (stars): comma-separated values from 2 to 5, e.g. '4,5'.

max_price.description: Maximum price per night in the selected currency.

min_price.description: Minimum price per night in the selected currency.

next_page_token.description: Token from a prior response to fetch the next page of results.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

property_token.description: Token for a single property from a prior search result; returns that property's full details. Still pass check_in_date and check_out_date.

property_types.description: Filter by property type: comma-separated type ids (see property_types in a prior response).

q.description: Search query: a destination, area, or hotel name (e.g. 'Bali resorts', 'hotels in Paris').

sort_by.description: Sort order: 3 = lowest price, 8 = highest rating, 13 = most reviewed. Omit for SerpAPI's default relevance ranking.

special_offers.description: Only show properties with special offers. Default false.

vacation_rentals.description: Search vacation rentals instead of hotels. Default false (hotels).

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_hotels_search
title: Search Google Hotels (SerpAPI)
